title: Q-UIUX-performance-ttfb: front-end performance: ttfb
body:
**Owner:** uiux-manager
**Trigger:** the UI/UX audit found `ttfb` (performance) on 1 page view(s)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation uiux --probe performance-ttfb
**Status:** open

UIUX-1 finding. 1700ms > 800

Pages: ultrastable.org/ (phone)

Fix the page or the shared component that renders it (site/ and the design tokens), keep the single-primary-action, 44px tap, AA contrast and plain-language rules, and never relax doctrine/uiux.json to clear the finding. Re-run `node scripts/uiux_audit.mjs --only <path>` to confirm.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation uiux --probe performance-ttfb` exits 0 (the finding no longer reproduces).
